# Parley v0.1.63

This unnotarized test beta makes Parley workable with many workspaces. It
adds a sectioned sidebar, workspace groups, Go to Workspace (Command-Shift-O)
and overflow tabs. Pane operations now finish completely or change nothing,
and a relay ticket survives sleep.

## No restart needed

The agent protocol is unchanged at version 33. Panes started under v0.1.62
keep working after the update.

## A sidebar for many workspaces

- The sidebar starts with **This Workspace**, the panes you are working in.
  Below it, **Needs Attention** lists other workspaces with something waiting
  on you. **Pinned** holds the workspaces you pin (Pin to Sidebar on a
  workspace's right-click menu), and you drag to reorder them. **Recent**
  shows up to five you used last, once you have more than eight.
  **All Workspaces** lists every one, collapsed by default past eight. Each
  workspace's attached folders are collapsed until you open them.
- **Workspace groups:** New Group… in the + beside All Workspaces, or Move to
  Group on a workspace. All Workspaces then lists your groups in order, then
  Ungrouped.
  - Click a group to show or hide it. Right-click it to rename, move or
    delete it.
  - Deleting a group moves its workspaces to Ungrouped and closes nothing.
  - Drag a workspace to reorder it within its group.
- **Go to Workspace (Command-Shift-O, Navigate menu):** type part of a name,
  group or folder and press Return. Workspaces waiting on you come first,
  then the most recently used, and the current one last. It works while a
  terminal has focus.
- **With the sidebar hidden and more than eight workspaces,** the tabs show
  your pinned workspaces, the current one and those waiting on you. They stay
  in your order, so a tab never changes place. **More** opens Go to Workspace
  for the rest.
- **A pane's Move to Workspace menu** lists pinned and recent workspaces
  first, then a submenu per group and Ungrouped.
- The sidebar's badges are computed once per update rather than rescanned
  for every row on every draw.

## Needs Attention and the menu-bar count clear

- A failed, interrupted or waiting handoff now counts as needing you until
  you open it in Status Center, and for at most a day after it happened.
  Before, it counted until history retention dropped it, because only results
  could be marked read.
- A returned result still counts until you read it. The pane history menu
  offers Mark Seen for a failure.

## Pane operations finish or change nothing

- Closing a workspace or a pane, stopping, starting, restarting, creating and
  moving panes, quitting and Prepare to Uninstall now save first. If the save
  fails they put everything back. A process ends only once its change is
  saved.
  - Before, a state file or credential store that could not be written could
    leave panes gone or stopped in the window while the error said otherwise.
  - Quitting could leave Parley open with every pane gone.
- Close stopped team panes carries on past a pane that fails to close, then
  lists what it skipped and why. A team Stop whose save fails now reads as
  failed and can be retried.

## Sleep and wake

- A command started just as the Mac goes to sleep is no longer refused on
  wake with "the ticket is invalid, expired or already used". Relay tickets
  now count only time the Mac is awake.
- A team pane request no longer fails because of a sleep or a clock change.
  A container member whose Docker preparation takes longer than 90 seconds
  is no longer failed and torn down.

## Other fixes

- A context-pack send cancelled while its text was being pasted is closed as
  failed, rather than offered again as a draft that might be sent twice. A
  send refused before anything reached the pane, such as Copilot folder trust
  not yet confirmed, keeps the draft ready to send.
- Status Center keeps the handoff it was asked to show when its workspace
  scope changes.
- The workspace and folder right-click menus no longer change under the
  pointer while open. Every item is also a VoiceOver action.
- The split divider no longer leaves a resize cursor behind after zooming a
  pane.
- Help opens the same topic again when asked twice. The Compatibility &
  Releases sheet has a Done button.
- The sidebar no longer checks every favourite folder on disk on every draw.

## Validation and known limits

The release workflow repeats the deterministic checks, the repository scans,
the app build, the 25-round Ghostty soak, packaging, checksums and
packaged-launch verification before publishing this beta.

Checked in code and automated checks, but not yet by hand in the app:
- the new sidebar sections and pinning;
- workspace groups, including a drag across a group header, which should
  only reorder within one group;
- Go to Workspace;
- the overflow tabs and More;
- the grouped Move to Workspace menu;
- the v0.1.62 items still waiting for a hand test.

Going back to an older Parley keeps your workspaces and panes, but its next
save drops pins, groups and group membership.

This is an ad-hoc-signed, unnotarized test beta. It does not update the
stable Sparkle feed or Homebrew cask. Follow the included installation
instructions.
